title: Electric wind
description: Air near a sharp point at high voltage becomes charged and is pushed away, making a breeze with no moving parts. It runs silent air purifiers, and in 2018 it flew a model plane with no propeller.
effect: a sharp point at high voltage blows a breeze
pickWhy: Old, named, simple, and the future-tech kind: lots of jobs not yet done by it.
edbDesc: A stream of ionized fluid generated by a strong electric field (typically a sharp conductive point) exceeding the corona discharge inception voltage gradient, ionizing the air about the tip, creating a small jet of plasma. Ionised air molecules have the same polarity as the charged tip, so are replused as a like-charged ion cloud, that expands due to the repulsion between ions, creating an electric 'wind' and a hissing noise due to pressure change.
